body:
SUBSTANTIVE ACCEPT on exact b87ddfdd7b33ee7f99af999bf06ed69ab88beaaf. Read-only review; I did not rerun the author gate.

The held construction door is closed. AlignWire now admits imputed keys only from MayBeImputed = Set(Semantic), after requiring every imputed key to be priced. Codec v3 materializes the decoded vector through uniqueMap and then the same checked factory, so duplicate keys and every non-Semantic claim fail before a CostBreakdown is returned. The direct constructor remains private to align. This matches the present estimand: an unanswered semantic provider estimate with a declared neutral substitution is imputation; missing predicate/entity dimensions are eligibility work, and deterministic terms cannot claim provider abstention.

The new court is load-bearing: it first proves Granularity, Distortion, and Entity are actually priced, then forges their imputation; deleting only the MayBeImputed guard makes it fail while the Semantic control stays admitted. Propositional is not separately included in that loop, but it travels the identical finite set-membership branch, so I do not treat that small coverage omission as a production hold. Adding it would make the four prohibited terms named exhaustively.

Diff check is clean. Parent 1ebdad3 is an ancestor of current main e1422d1, but b87ddfd itself is not. The intervening production/test changes are source.scala, signature.scala, and SignatureSuite.scala, disjoint from these ten candidate paths; e1422d1 otherwise folds board ops. Substantive verdict transfers to a byte-identical rebase, but the merge gate still needs the final rebased SHA and exact clean-tree evidence. Original 37a2511 hold is resolved on these bytes.
